call_points.text: Management expects Central India cement demand to grow by 7% to 7.5% this fiscal, aided by UP elections.
Company repaid a ₹687 million interest-free loan and is now completely debt free.
Company continues to operate on negative net operating working capital.
Board recommended a dividend of ₹7 per share.
call_points.versus_prior: dividend now recommended by the board; shareholder approval at the AGM still pending

call_points.text: Company was declared preferred bidder for two mining leases in Madhya Pradesh.
Management expects the GST cut on cement from 28% to 18% during FY26 to lift consumption in the short to medium term.
Upcoming Uttar Pradesh elections are expected to provide impetus to cement demand in Central India.
Management flags the West Asia conflict, elevated inflation and currency depreciation as continuing uncertainties.
El Niño may pose a risk to agricultural output, rural demand and food inflation.
With input prices rising, management says it will try to pass the increase on to customers.

timeline.summary: Heidelberg Materials South Asia B.V. (formerly Cementrum I BV) declares no share encumbrance in HeidelbergCement India Limited during FY2026, signed by M.C.M. Cremers and I.M.W. Westerhof-Zwevernink, Members of the Management Board.

HeidelbergCement India received consent to establish dated 17 May 2026 from the Madhya Pradesh Pollution Control Board for a cement blending and grinding unit at Dongaliya, Khandwa, tied to long-term fly-ash supply on leased land.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹646.22 Cr (+5.5% YoY), net profit ₹45.21 Cr (-10.4% YoY).

HeidelbergCement India's FY26 investor presentation (29 May 2026) showed EBITDA per tonne up 10.2% to ₹584 for FY26 but down 10% to ₹649 in Q4FY26, a debt-free balance sheet with ₹4,037 million cash and bank balance, and a recommended ₹7 per share dividend.

HeidelbergCement India Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4 & FY2026 results via **mycemco.com** on **29 May 2026**, signed by **Ravi Arora, Vice President-Corporate Affairs & Investor Relations**.
HeidelbergCement India held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 29, 2026, reporting debt-free status, rising green power share, and ongoing expansion plans in Khandwa.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹567.78 Cr (+11.0% YoY), net profit ₹16.77 Cr (-32.7% YoY).
